deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.2.description: Chosen as default because Atlas Cloud is an aggregator with no single house model, and this is the model its own LLM API Protocols page (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/llm-protocols, retrieved 2026-09-29) uses in its chat-completions curl and OpenAI-SDK snippets, its Anthropic Messages example and its Responses example (the Gemini and Images examples on that page use a MODEL_ID placeholder instead, and the quick start, API Keys and LLM / Chat pages use a shorter deepseek-v3 that is not a roster id); its LLM / Chat page (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/models/llm) lists DeepSeek V3 first among Featured Models. Live on the unauthenticated GET https://api.atlascloud.ai/v1/models roster (2026-09-29, 120 models): context_length 163840, max_output_length 163840 (equal to the context window, so not recorded as a distinct output ceiling), FP8, input_modalities text only, supported_features json_mode, structured_outputs, tools, reasoning. Pricing from the same roster: $0.26 / $0.38 per MTok input/output, $0.13 per MTok cached-input read. Context-window conflict, unresolved by the vendor: the marketing copy and spec table on the model page (https://www.atlascloud.ai/models/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.2, retrieved 2026-09-29) say '128K token context length support' and 'Context Length 128K tokens', while the roster field and the same page's machine-readable reference (https://www.atlascloud.ai/models/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.2/llms.txt, retrieved 2026-09-29: 'Context length: 163,840 tokens', 'Max output tokens: 163,840') both say 163,840. The catalog records 163840 (here and in models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens) because the two API-facing sources agree on it; no request longer than 128K tokens was sent, so the range between 128K and 163,840 is declared by the vendor, not tested. Roster-verified only; not capability-probed without a key.

errorRules.message: Atlas Cloud rejected the request with HTTP 401. Check {apiKeyEnvVar} (create a key at {setupUrl}); Atlas Cloud also answers 401 for a mistyped endpoint path, so confirm the base URL ends in /v1
Atlas Cloud reports an insufficient balance (HTTP 402). Add funds at https://www.atlascloud.ai/console/billing and retry
Atlas Cloud model '{model}' was not found or is not available to your account (HTTP 404). Pick a current id from https://api.atlascloud.ai/v1/models

instructions: 1. Visit: https://www.atlascloud.ai/login and sign up or sign in (Google, GitHub, or email and password — one page handles both, see https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/account/sign-in)

2. Open https://www.atlascloud.ai/console/api-keys, choose Create API Key and copy it immediately — it is shown only once (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/api-keys), and Atlas Cloud API keys begin with apikey- (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/llm-protocols)

3. Billing is pay-as-you-go from a prepaid balance: the quick start's Step 3 is Add Funds with a $25 minimum top-up (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/get-started), and requests are rejected with 402 while the balance is insufficient (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/errors). The homepage FAQ also says 'No credit card required to start', but no free-tier terms are documented, so check your balance at https://www.atlascloud.ai/console/billing before relying on it
4. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY, the name used in Atlas Cloud's own docs, is also read)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.atlascloud.ai/v1 (https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/llm-protocols: POST /v1/chat/completions, Bearer auth, 'Point an existing SDK at Atlas Cloud and it generally works unchanged'); the same base URL also accepts Anthropic Messages, Responses and Gemini formats, which NeuroLink does not use. The roster (unauthenticated GET /v1/models, 200, 120 models, 2026-09-29) comes back in a custom {code, msg, data} envelope rather than OpenAI's {object: 'list'} wrapper; data is still an array of {id, ...} entries. The is_ready field on that roster was false on 73 of the 120 entries (by id prefix: anthropic/ 29, openai/ 18, google/ 11, qwen/ 8, xai/ 4, moonshotai/ 2, zai-org/ 1) and absent on the other 47; the models in this catalog are entries where it is absent. Per the LLM API Protocols page, response_format (json_object and json_schema) is documented for models that advertise json_mode or structured_outputs and tools for models that advertise tools, /v1/embeddings does not exist, the gateway inserts 'You are a helpful assistant.' when no system prompt is sent, and 429 responses carry no Retry-After header (back off client-side). Error body per https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/errors: {"code":401,"msg":"unauthorized","request_id":"...","data":null}; a wrong path also returns 401, 402 means insufficient balance, and a 404 covers models not available to the account. Billing status is unresolved: the docs and the API describe a funded balance, while the homepage FAQ says 'No credit card required to start' (the phrase 'free credits' appears only in the homepage blurbs for the GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana 2 models, with no terms) — no page states what a brand-new account can call, so no-free-tier is the conservative schema value, not a verified fact.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.atlascloud.ai/v1/models — 120 models; credential-free, no key used

billingProbe.method: public pages https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/billing, /docs/billing/topup, /docs/billing/credits, /docs/get-started and the https://www.atlascloud.ai homepage — pay-as-you-go prepaid balance, $25 minimum top-up, 402 on insufficient balance; homepage FAQ separately says 'No credit card required to start'; the pages do not reconcile; credential-free
